W4 does not pass round 1. Two done criteria fail, both in the bot soak.
(1) done:2 / gameplay:G1 (blocker): deaths to Wicks or monsters with no enemy fighter involved reach 8.2 % at veteran on seeds 1-20 and 10.1 % on fresh seeds 21-40 (75 of 817 deaths pooled, 9.2 %), against a target of 5 % or less.
